meta.title: The New Blue Door
meta.textType: time: the hours of the day

paragraphs: Our house has an old door. It is ten years old. Today we paint it blue. At eight o'clock, Dad puts paper on the floor. At nine o'clock, Dad paints the door. Tom paints it too. The paint is very blue. Tom has blue hands. I look at the blue door.

At eleven o'clock, I draw a flower. It is a big yellow flower. I put it next to the door. "It is beautiful!" says Mom. At twelve o'clock, we have lunch. Where is Pip? We look in the kitchen. He is not there.

At two o'clock, we see Pip. He runs on the floor. He has blue feet! There is blue paint on the paper and the floor. "Oh no, Pip!" says Dad. We clean the floor. At five o'clock, the door is blue. The floor is clean. I like it. Do you have a door at home? What color is it?
text.summary: Lily tells us how the family paints the old door of their house blue. Pip runs on the floor with blue feet.
